page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Marginal notes in the left margin, keyed by letters (a, b, c, f) and numbers (1 to 4). Running head at the top right, page number at the top left. Catchword "Atqui" at the bottom right.

main_text.p: Papæ loquentes, quæ in novis Bibliis circumferun-tur, diceremus ipsos arbitrari Papam, qui unus est Romæ, habere in provinciis multos collegas minores, id est, multa idola ejusdem nominis? Aut, ut ad Bellarminum propius accedamus, a Comment. in Hof. prophet.cap.2.§.66.Ribera Ie-suita, declarans, etsi Baal unus certúsque sit Deus, tamen a Prophetis memorari b Iud.2.11.1. Sam.7.3.Hof. 1.13.& 11.2.Baalim, hoc est, Baales, numero multitudinis, quòd idem Baal varia variis in templis habuerit simulacra, quorum unumquodque vocabatur Baal; exempli gratia, Baal Peor, seu Beel-phegor (ut vetus interpres legit) & Beel Zebub: ficut, inquit, apud Christianos (si modo in vanis licet exemplis uti religiosis) beatissima Virgo nunc Lauretana invocatur, nunc a Montesferato, nunc ab Amnelupi, aut a Rupe Gallica cognomen accipit. c Supra,lib.2. cap.2.§.5. 1 Maria Lauretana.Caute quidem ille praemunitione illa, si modo licet, parenthesi inclusa seipsum sapiens & obvallans, ne horribilis blasphemiæ damnetur cum Erasmo, quòd beatam Virginem, ut in Italia colitur, 1 Italiaidolo Moabitarum comparet; idolo autem Accaronis Philistæorumque, ut in Hispania: sed obiter ostendens Papistas, etsi multa Mariæ faciant simulacra, quæ Marias, ut Baalim, appellare possis, Mariam tamen unam colere. Quòd si Pontificii cum Ribera sentiant, se non instituere multiplicare Marias, utcunque multas faciant Mariæ imagines; nec eam hæc idola, sed Sanctos, pro collegis minoribus habere: dissipata igitur Bellar-minianæ impofturæ nebula, clarissimum rationis Calvini lumen emicat. Nam & omnium eorum, qui nomine duodecim Deorum celebrabantur, imagines habebant Ethnici d Varr. de re rust.l.1. c.1.Romæ, e Paufan.Att.Athenis, ac Megaris, una positas: & f Cic.in Verr. li.4. Plin.nat. hist.lib.34.c.7.& 8.Paufa.& c.hist.ubi-que.singulorum ibi alibique passim, in plurimis, tum publicis locis, tum privatis.

page.notes: Printed marks in the text: a (before Ribera), b (before Baalim), c (before Erasmo), 1 (before Italia), 2 (before idolo Moabitarum), 3 (before idolo autem), 4 (before Hispania), d (before Romæ), e or c (before Athenis; the mark reads as c, but the margin note is e: doubtful), f (before singulorum). The margin notes are numbered 2, 3 and 4 as well: "2 Baal Peor. Num.25.3." (beside the line of Erasmo), "3 Beel-zebub.2.Reg.1.2." and "4 Maria a Monte Serrato, Maria a Rupe Gallica. Nam hi duo famosi peregrinationum in Hispania loci sunt. Marin.Sic.de reb.Hispaniae lib.5." are in the left margin and are not placed in the XML above. Their exact position in the text cannot be fixed with certainty. Doubtful readings: "1.13.& 11.2." in note b; "li.4." and "lib.34." in note f; "tamē" and "impofturæ" in the text; "posita" versus "positas"; "Paufa." and "Paufan.Att." in notes e and f. The note "c Supra" is placed beside the line "men accipit", the place where it stands in the margin, though the reference mark c is in the text at Erasmo.
